function.arguments: {"message":"Hi there! When an invite stops working after you’ve added a certain number of people, it’s usually because you’ve hit the seat limit for your current plan. You can see the limit and how many seats are in use under **Settings → Billing → Plan**. If the invite is being blocked with no seats available, it means you’ve reached that tier’s maximum. To add more users you’ll need to either remove an existing seat (removing a person frees the seat immediately, and you can invite a new person within the same billing cycle without increasing the seat count) or upgrade to a plan with a higher seat limit."}

arguments.message: Hi there! When an invite stops working after you’ve added a certain number of people, it’s usually because you’ve hit the seat limit for your current plan. You can see the limit and how many seats are in use under **Settings → Billing → Plan**. If the invite is being blocked with no seats available, it means you’ve reached that tier’s maximum. To add more users you’ll need to either remove an existing seat (removing a person frees the seat immediately, and you can invite a new person within the same billing cycle without increasing the seat count) or upgrade to a plan with a higher seat limit.
